errors.noBody: Cannot export: there is no body.
errors.unknownBody: Cannot export: a chosen body no longer exists.
errors.blocked: Export blocked: a body failed the check. The body list gives the reason.
errors.invalidNames: Cannot export: the product name is missing or longer than 200 characters.
errors.writeFailed: Export failed: the file could not be written. Check the folder and write permissions.
errors.verifyFailed: Export failed: the written file does not match the model. An existing file is unchanged.
